biography.plain_text: Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan is an Emirati royal and diplomat, and a son of UAE founder Sheikh Zayed. After studying political science at UAE University, he entered federal service, first as an undersecretary and then as minister of information and culture. He became foreign minister in 2006 and deputy prime minister in 2024, placing him at the centre of the federation's international diplomacy. His standing derives from the Al Nahyan dynasty and public office, not a publicly documented entrepreneurial fortune.
